北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感舒适，户外活动很不错哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and pleasant, great for outdoor activities!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降12℃

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波阴天，气温舒适，适合悠闲地度过一天哦。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is overcast with comfortable temperatures, perfect for a relaxing day.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温适宜，体感舒适，记得添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, temperature is nice. Stay comfy and dress warmly!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗，体感温暖，湿度高，记得多补充水分哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm, but humid. Remember to hydrate!
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降8℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，风力较大，出门注意防风防晒哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny with strong winds. Mind the wind and sun when out!
深圳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，气温宜人，散步休闲的好天气。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast with pleasant temperatures, perfect for a stroll.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，能见度低，出行注意交通安全哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has fog, visibility is low. Drive safely!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度较高，体感偏暖，小心闷热哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and humid, feels warm. Beware of mugginess!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，湿度大，出行请注意安全，放慢车速哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and humid. Please travel safely and drive slowly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，气温适中，体感舒适，注意适时添减衣物。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast with moderate, comfy temperatures. Dress appropriately!
西安.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，湿度大，能见度低，出行小心慢行哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and humid, with low visibility. Travel carefully!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴冷，体感偏低，一定要多穿暖和衣服哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cold and overcast, feels even colder. Dress warmly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，气温偏凉，早晚温差大，注意保暖哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but cool. Mind the temperature changes and stay warm!
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降10℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴天，气温适中，体感舒适，享受阳光吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant. Enjoy the sunshine!
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，风力较大，户外注意防风防晒哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny with strong winds. Mind the wind and sun outdoors!
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，风力较大，体感略凉，出门注意防风哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny with strong winds, feels cool. Mind the wind when out!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，湿度大，能见度低，开车出门务必小心。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy and humid with low visibility. Drive carefully if out!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦晴朗温暖，湿度较高，多补充水分，注意防晒。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is sunny and warm, but humid. Hydrate and use sun protection!
漳浦.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天湿润，体感略热，注意保持清爽哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and humid, feels a bit warm. Stay fresh!
